title: Super Simple Cold Brew Coffee
description: All you need is a jar, a tea infuser, and some ground coffee.

recipe.name: Super Simple Cold Brew Coffee
recipe.description: All you need is a jar, a tea infuser, and some ground coffee.

recipeInstructions.text: Grind coffee beans coarsely and add to the tea infuser.
Place the tea infuser into a mason jar.
Pour room temperature or colder water over the coffee, refilling periodically as it passes through the grounds, until it is close to the top.
Cover, place in the refrigerator, and let sit for 18+ hours.
